claude.performance_metric: Both businesses re-sold within ~3.1-3.5 years: home-health arm fully acquired by Humana for $8.2bn enterprise value (Aug 2021), hospital/rehab arm recombined into ScionHealth (Dec 2021)
claude.rationale: The slice documents only subsequent changes of ownership — Humana's full acquisition of Kindred at Home (with a $1,129M gain and $128M transaction/integration costs recognized) and the formation of ScionHealth from the hospital/rehabilitation assets — without any account of realized disruption at the product/process interface, so p4 is coded 0 (none documented). Likewise, no documented operations-vs-organization fracture (culture, management, integration breaking against people) appears; the only personnel note is CEO Breier's planned departure at the ScionHealth launch, which is not framed as an integration fracture, so p5 is coded 0. The slice contains no evidence bearing on controlling-intent archetype coherence or business-model reconcilability over time, so t1 and t2 are uncertain.
